content: edge-tts (pypi, rany2/edge-tts) is at v7.2.8 (uploaded 2026-03-22), LGPLv3 license (one file MIT), deps aiohttp/certifi/tabulate/typing-extensions. Default output audio-24khz-48kbitrate-mono-mp3 (native MP3, no encoder needed). SSML custom breaks removed since v5.0.0 -- pauses must be built by concatenating generated silence, not <break> tags. GitHub issues show recurring 403/NoAudioReceived breakage tied to Microsoft trusted-token changes (unofficial reverse-engineered API, no documented rate limit).
